title: apex-3v1s LNR TERRA; semantic receipt required

steps.prompt: Use native tool search to discover the archive server's read-only package_manifest tool, which reads the isolated probe-build pager Cargo manifest. Invoke the discovered function directly using its returned name and schema. Do not call search_tool, use_tool, shell, read-file, pty, weave, or any other lookup tool. After the successful tool result, reply HTS-3V1S-LNR-TERRA-RESULT followed by the complete JSON object from that result and nothing else.
Without calling any tool, repeat the complete JSON object from the previous archive package_manifest tool result. Prefix your answer with HTS-3V1S-LNR-TERRA-DONE and include nothing else.
